mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_expense_draft_run(tenant_id,id,report_id,application_id,requested_by, application_version,financial_version,status,version,active_report_id,context_json,state_json,created_at,trace_id) SELECT r.tenant_id,#{id},r.id,r.application_id,r.employee_id,a.version,r.version,'QUEUED',1,r.id,#{stateJson},#{stateJson2},#{createdAt},#{traceId} FROM expense_report r JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=r.tenant_id AND a.id=r.application_id WHERE r.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND r.id=#{reportId} AND r.application_id=#{applicationId} AND r.employee_id=#{requestedBy} AND a.created_by=r.employee_id AND a.version=#{applicationVersion} AND r.version=#{financialVersion} AND a.status IN ('DRAFT','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN') AND a.business_type='EXPENSE' AND a.business_id=r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_expense_draft_run SET status=#{status},version=#{version},state_json=#{stateJson},active_report_id=#{reportId},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status=#{previous} AND context_json=#{contextJson}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_expense_draft_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM agent_expense_draft_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no FROM agent_expense_draft_run q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.status='QUEUED' OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10

SELECT id,application_version,financial_version,status,version,created_at FROM agent_expense_draft_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{reportId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_expense_draft_run WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND report_id=#{reportId}
